QuestInfo.name: [Lunar New Year Mission] Deliver Shade's Message
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Shade again to get the finished message.
QuestInfo.1: Shade's message is for #bMoonbeam#k in Fox Point Village on Vulpes in Grandis. This is the farthest delivery mission so far. The easiest way to get to Vulpes is to #btell Cartalion in Pantheon that it's a request by Tumbleweed#k. Don't forget that Cartalion is a #bNova with horns shaped like a handle#k!
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the message to #bMoonbeam#k in Fox Point Village, but she thinks it was misdelivered. Why would Shade send a message to someone he doesn't know? How does he know Moonbeam?

default.0: Please deliver the message to #bMoonbeam in Fox Point Village#k. \r\nTell #bCartalion in Pantheon#k on Grandis that it's a request by Tumbleweed, and he'll send you straight there. \r\n
